name: Workforce Non-Industrial Work Cycle — Building Management

h0.content: Non-industrial work cycle — building maintenance technician perspective (ADR-0026 diagram 4 of 5, resolves Q4)

n1.content: technician_authenticate: QR onboarding / WebAuthn passkey / OTP on technician mobile PWA (not corporate email+password)

n2.content: load_own_org_path_subtree: cache ONLY technician's assigned property zone (e.g. /building-12/plumbing-hvac/), not full property portfolio (data-minimization)

n3.content: technician device online (e.g. in basement utility room)?

n4.content: fetch_work_order_queue: MCP tools/call, tenant_id + org_path scoped, allowed_tools per harness_specs.agent_name

n5.content: load_work_order_queue: from local encrypted IndexedDB/OPFS cache (last synced) — displays cached maintenance tickets (data may be stale)

n6.content: technician selects/opens maintenance ticket (e.g. resident reported pipe leak in Apt 4B)

n7.content: render_current_step: State-Machine Step Runner renders ONLY current DRAKON IR node (e.g. 'isolate riser valve 12-B')

n8.content: current step is a diagnostic branch / choice?

n9.content: technician selects diagnostic branch (DRAKON question one/two) -> advance current_step_id

n10.content: technician performs maintenance action / captures evidence (photo of pipe joint, pressure gauge reading, QR scan of replacement seal)

n11.content: schematics, spare parts, or guidance needed from Property Coordinator Agent?

n12.content: technician -> AI Property Coordinator Agent: MCP tools/call against coordinator's harness_specs.allowed_tools (Slice 3.4a/4.4 pattern — queries building plumbing schematics and inventory)

n14.content: anomaly / undocumented building condition encountered (e.g. non-standard copper-to-PEX adapter)?

n15.content: technician logs Operational Field Record / Micro-ADR (3 fields: context / action / result + photo) -> local queue, status PENDING_REVIEW

n16.content: technician finalizes work order result + field record into local encrypted queue, status PENDING_REVIEW (no auto-promotion, no confidence-score merge)

n18.content: sync_work_order: workforce.synclogs + workforce.submitmicroadr (MCP) -> D1 tenant_work_items (with 5 provenance columns: created_by, created_by_kind, created_at, assigned_by, assigned_at) and tenant_micro_adrs; verifier runs advisory-only

n19.content: remain in local encrypted offline queue, retry on browser 'online' event — event-driven polling, not a persistent WebSocket (battery)

n20.content: more maintenance tickets assigned in today's duty period?

n21.content: technician reports duty-period status summary (completed work orders, pending supervisor reviews)

end.content: Duty period ends. Completed maintenance records and PENDING_REVIEW operational notes wait in Building Operations Manager Review Queue.

meta.description: Diagram 4 of ADR-0026 detailing list ('non-industrial example end-to-end: building management'). Pressure-tests the workforce state-machine work cycle against a residential building maintenance use case (resident report -> coordinator dispatch -> technician execution -> field knowledge capture).

vocabulary_generalization.shift: duty_period (neutral primitive: DutyCycle — technician's scheduled duty window / on-call period)
vocabulary_generalization.brigade: team_pod (neutral primitive: TeamPod — e.g. Building 12 HVAC & Plumbing Team)
vocabulary_generalization.supervisor: coordinator_agent (neutral primitive: CoordinatorAgent — e.g. Property Operations Manager / Dispatcher)
vocabulary_generalization.factory_workshop: property_zone (neutral primitive: OrgUnit — e.g. Building Complex / Multi-Apartment Building / Utility Core)
vocabulary_generalization.worker: specialist_participant (neutral primitive: ParticipantRole — e.g. Field Maintenance Technician)
vocabulary_generalization.shift_queue: duty_work_order_queue (neutral primitive: ScopedWorkItemQueue — e.g. tenant_work_items scoped to /building-12/plumbing/)
vocabulary_generalization.micro_adr: operational_field_record (neutral primitive: OperationalRecord — e.g. building defect / non-standard fitting log)

confirmed_against_code.proposed_unimplemented_symbols: tenant_work_items, ScopedWorkItemRepository, tenant_micro_adrs, ScopedMicroAdrRepository, DrakonStepRunner, EvidenceCapture, OfflineSyncBanner, useWorkforceStore — GitNexus query/context confirmed 0 live code symbols (proposed in 002-workforce-tables.sql and Slice 5.1 plan)

offline_sync_conflict.note: Technician working in basement/shielded utility rooms with zero connectivity. Local writes record updated_at version witness; sync compares version on reconnect to prevent overwriting concurrent dispatch changes.

device_loss_theft.note: Local caching limited strictly to technician's assigned property zone (/building-12/); encrypted at rest via WebCrypto over IndexedDB with passkey or PIN-derived key.

multilingual_runtime.note: Resident maintenance request or coordinator guidance localized via translation catalogue; coordinator MCP queries translate domain terminology seamlessly.

native_hardware_battery.note: Evidence captured via standard web APIs (getUserMedia photo, camera barcode scan) with manual fallback; sync is event-driven (online event + visibilitychange) without persistent WebSocket battery drain.

not_covered_by_this_diagram: Resident-facing ticket submission portal / tenant intake flow (external integration boundary)
Automated procurement and parts ordering ERP integration
Q6 multi-building tenant hierarchy visibility rules
